title: Force buy ToyBox for anyone who sets approval for contract
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In ToyBox contract and `primarySaleWithPermit()` and `customSaleWithPermit()` code doesn't check that `msg.sender` is equal to the `permitSignature.owner`. Also valid permission signature is not enforced in `trustlessPermit()` so If someone has set approval for the ToyBox contract, it would be possible to call those functions with spoofed permission signature and buy ToyBox token for them without their permission.
